{{Quote|More and more, Senator Palpatine, you begin to sound like my former master.''"<br />"''Would that I had such talents.|Ronhar Kim and Palpatine on the former's master|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
An '''individual''' was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ronhar Kim]]. In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Kim and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] discussed Kim's father, [[Vidar Kim]] during the latter's [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]]. During that discussion, Kim told Palpatine that he sounded&mdash;more and more as he spoke&mdash;as his master.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ronhar Kim's Jedi Master was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
